proposed_claim: Forecast accuracy does not necessarily equal battery peak-shaving decision value.
internal_evidence: 6/8 forecast- and decision-selected weights differ; Phase 7 winner alignment 2/8 and rank agreement 0.344
external_evidence: Building-storage and industrial-BESS studies report asymmetric or misaligned forecast/control value
allowed_wording: In this experiment and prior studies, standard forecast accuracy did not fully represent downstream storage decision value.
prohibited_wording: We discovered/proved universally that accuracy never predicts decision value.

proposed_claim: DOEF selects a DayWeek-LightGBM ensemble weight using Validation battery decision regret.
internal_evidence: Formula, weights, objective, tie-breaks and Test role are frozen
external_evidence: Prior work covers value-based model selection and decision-focused pooling
allowed_wording: DOEF is a lightweight decision-oriented ensemble-selection method for this building peak-shaving setting.
prohibited_wording: DOEF is the first decision-focused ensemble or a new end-to-end DFL algorithm.

proposed_claim: DOEF improved normalized decision regret versus LightGBM on the frozen eight-building Test.
internal_evidence: 6/2/0 wins/ties/losses; 3.6147% relative mean normalized-regret improvement; building bootstrap interval below zero
external_evidence: None required for the internal result
allowed_wording: On eight selected office buildings and one fixed Test month, DOEF reduced mean normalized regret versus LightGBM.
prohibited_wording: DOEF universally improves storage scheduling or works on all buildings.

proposed_claim: Multi-building Train-only representative selection reduces cherry-picking risk.
internal_evidence: 82 eligible of 296 office candidates; 8 selected using Train morphology; negative CatBoost case retained
external_evidence: Multi-building evaluation is established; literature motivates scope reporting
allowed_wording: The protocol improves evaluation rigor and reduces performance-based building selection risk.
prohibited_wording: A novel forecasting algorithm or proof of unseen-building generalization.

proposed_claim: The project provides an auditable forecast-to-dispatch evidence chain.
internal_evidence: Canonical configs, predictions, dispatch, audits, lineage and fail-closed loader exist
external_evidence: Reproducible datasets and code-backed decision-focused work show the value of traceability
allowed_wording: A reproducible, machine-readable forecast-to-storage evaluation pipeline is an engineering contribution.
prohibited_wording: Industrial deployment readiness or real-world bill/emissions reduction.

proposed_claim: Phase 5.7 robust optimization improved Test performance.
internal_evidence: Robust mean regret and tail peak were worse than deterministic LightGBM
external_evidence: Robustness complexity does not guarantee out-of-sample gains
allowed_wording: The failed robust strategy is retained as a falsification and stop-rule result.
prohibited_wording: Robust optimization improved Test peak shaving.

proposed_claim: LightGBM is comprehensively the best forecasting method.
internal_evidence: Phase 3 Test MAE trails persistence; Phase 7 winners vary by building and model
external_evidence: Building-load literature shows context-dependent model performance
allowed_wording: LightGBM is one frozen component and a strong three-tree aggregate comparator.
prohibited_wording: LightGBM is best on every metric/building.

proposed_claim: DOEF is industrially deployed and lowers actual electricity bills or carbon emissions.
internal_evidence: No tariff, cost, carbon, deployment or online control model
external_evidence: Prior works model costs explicitly; DOEF does not
allowed_wording: DOEF has simulated peak-shaving application value under the frozen protocol.
prohibited_wording: Proven bill savings, emissions reduction, renewable absorption or industrial deployment.

proposed_claim: Phase 5.7 demonstrates stop-rule and anti-cherry-picking discipline.
internal_evidence: Validation-selected robust strategy failed on Test and was retained without retuning
external_evidence: External evidence not required for repository conduct
allowed_wording: The retained negative result demonstrates falsification-oriented evaluation discipline.
prohibited_wording: The failure proves robust optimization is generally ineffective.
